Macrons

Consonantal i

Theme

Work & responsibility

work from home phrase

also working from home, remote work, work remotely, home office, WFH

our formation

domī labōrāre

phrase: the locative domī with labōrāre

work at home

A plain description; no reference work has a term for remote work. In the libellī the father works in the study of the house where he is staying, and the text says only that he works: labōrāre, with the place.

Examples

  • ego in tablīnum eō, ut labōrem

    I’m going into the study to workLibellus III, Apud avum et aviam

  • Hodiē pater domī labōrat.

    Daddy is working from home today.composed

See also office, study, laptop.

SourcesLewis & Short: laboro · Lewis & Short: domus

Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 11 November 2026. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word.

The example sentence marked “composed” is ours.
